Check fixture layer: a run-to-completion (one-shot) service beside the bed's long-running one.
Declares `check-init`, which runs to completion and exits 0 (`restart: no`, `start_sec: 0`,
`exit_code: "0"`) — the shape `pod-immich`'s `immich-db-init` has. Supervisord reports it as
EXITED, so `supervisorctl status` exits 3 on a HEALTHY pod; the `check-pod` bed uses it to
prove that `charly service status` judges the table rather than the tool's aggregate exit code
(opencharly/charly#1271).

## Services

- `check-init`

## Acceptance plan

This candy's `plan:` — the runnable spec `charly check` executes against a live deployment. `check:` steps are idempotent probes; `run:` steps change state.

| Intent | Step |
|---|---|
| `run` | install the one-shot service's body |
| `check` | the one-shot service's body is installed and executable |
